[P2] Complete the required design note for the public API changes

This introduces public transport factories while removing `DeciderConfig.agentCore` and renaming an exported client interface. The supplied description explains the chosen API but does not provide the alternatives comparison required by CONTRIBUTING rules 2.5 and 3, including consideration of the existing custom-transport extension point. Return to the design phase under rules 8 and 9: document the problem, cause, simpler alternatives, chosen option, and removals, and obtain maintainer agreement before proceeding.
